# Console commands

:material-circle:{ .level-advanced } Advanced

Every text command the firmware accepts, as registered in the source. Type them in the rusEFI console's command box; TunerStudio sends some of them through its own buttons. Arguments are separated by spaces. Commands for bench and factory testing drive outputs directly: read the bench-testing chapter and the safety page before using them on a connected engine.

!!! danger "Commands act immediately"
    Many commands switch outputs, change settings or reboot the ECU at once. On a car, injectors can spray fuel and coils can fire.
